_readme: Reader discount codes (Hank, Nov 4, 2026). A deal shows on the site only when it has a code and today is between start and end. families: truck-family slugs it applies to, or ["*"] for every page. The top bar shows the page's family deal (or a * deal); /deals/ lists every active deal; a code chip is added after every link to the deal's domains. chip_skip: words in a link's text that mean it's a third-party product the code may not cover; those links get no chip.

deals.note: Live Nov 4, 2026 from Colin (colin@eurowise.com). Code also covers their Cayenne, Touareg, Q7 and older VW parts, but we only show it on G-Class pages. Link to Shop By Vehicle, not the All Eurowise Products collection (Colin asked). Joint data review Jan 4, 2027; fraudulent or cancelled orders do not count.
deals.terms: Covers products Eurowise makes itself; third-party shock sets (Bilstein, Fox, King) without Eurowise parts are excluded. Unlimited uses. Doesn’t stack with other discounts: during Eurowise’s Black Friday sale you get whichever discount is higher. Ends at midnight on January 4, 2027.
